from_notes: Public-People Philanthropic Partnership (P4) approach: to achieve zero poverty in Andhra Pradesh within five years
x: P4 (Public-Private-People Partnership, launched Ugadi 30 March 2025) aims at complete eradication of poverty ('Zero Poverty'), linked to SDG 1. It is not a family-planning, IT-hub or mother-and-child health programme.
source: AP Socio-Economic Survey 2024-25 (src/economy/ap-socio-economic-survey-2024-25.txt) p.301-302

from_notes: Andhra Pradesh entered a strategic partnership with the Gates Foundation ... improve health, education, and agriculture
x: The AP government's 2025 partnership with the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation uses technology (AI, data, digital public infrastructure) to improve health, education and agriculture; the Foundation is also a partner of Project Sanjeevani. WHO, NITI Aayog and Tata Trusts were not the 2025 MoU partner.
source: CARE APPSC Feb 2026 (src/current-affairs/care-appsc-2026-02.txt) p.19-21
evidence: Rocket CA 2026 Parts 01-04: no line on the AP-Gates partnership

from_notes: treatment cost is covered up to Rs.25 lakhs per family per annum, with no limit for cancer treatment
